name: A W Hoss & Son, Inc.
old_description: A.W. Hoss and Son is Seattle's premiere upholsterer & fine furniture manufacturer. We are experienced, passionate, highly skilled
about:
A.W. Hoss & Son, Inc. has operated from Seattle, Washington since its founding in 1936 by A.W. Hoss. The company continues as a family-run upholstery and fine furniture manufacturer at 9221 Roosevelt Way NE in the city's Roosevelt neighborhood.

The shop designs, builds, upholsters, and restores furniture for residential and commercial clients. Capabilities span custom sofas, chairs, banquettes, built-ins, wall panels, and mid-century modern reproductions, using hardwood frames, coil springs, and a range of natural and synthetic fills. The facility houses what the company describes as the largest upholstery showroom in the metro area, stocking commercial-grade fabrics from lines such as Robert Allen, Kravet, and Duralee, alongside a green product line featuring recycled polyester, linen, flax, latex, soy-based foam, and reclaimed wood. A retail section sells DIY upholstery supplies including foam and fabric by the yard.

Clients span hospitality, corporate, institutional, and residential sectors. Hotel and restaurant accounts include Four Seasons, Hyatt Regency, The Westin, W Hotels, and local venues such as Blu Water Bistro and Salish Lodge. Corporate and institutional work covers Microsoft, the University of Washington, Virginia Mason Medical Center, Woodland Park Zoo, and the Frye Art Museum. Retail and entertainment projects have been delivered for Nordstrom, Nike Town, Simon Malls, and the Fifth Avenue Theatre.

The company emphasizes sustainable materials and antique restoration expertise as differentiators. Its "Green is our game" program specifies recycled and natural fabrics, latex and soy foams, and renewable wood. Craftsmen also specialize in antique repair, hand tufting, and Chesterfield-style work, positioning the shop as a resource for both historic preservation and new custom builds.
